question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A building or group of buildings in which religious men live and worship.
solution: The correct answer is: **Monastery** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Monastery **means a place where monks live together. (वह स्थान जहाँ साधु एक साथ रहते हों) • So, it is clear that '**Monastery**' can be used as a one-word substitute for 'A** building or group of buildings in which religious men live and worship**' Therefore, the correct answer is option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Villa **means a house that people rent and stay in on holiday. (एक घर जिसे लोग किराए पर लेते हैं और छुट्टी के दिन रहते हैं) • **Cottage **means a small and usually old house, especially in the country. (एक छोटा और आमतौर पर पुराना घर, खासकर देश में) • **Condo **means an individually owned residential unit in a complex or building. (एक परिसर या भवन में एक व्यक्तिगत स्वामित्व वाली आवासीय इकाई) 3c:Tb9c, The correct answer is: **"Disappear completely" **
